source: `go tool nm` listing of the pinned ELF (not committed)
rule: text symbols (nm type T or t) `<pkg>.<Type>.<Method>` or `<pkg>.(*<Type>).<Method>` with <pkg> under `github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/v7/` and <Method> in ['UnmarshalSSZ', 'MarshalSSZTo', 'MarshalSSZ', 'SizeSSZ', 'HashTreeRoot', 'HashTreeRootWith', 'ProgressiveHashTreeRoot', 'ProgressiveHashTreeRootWith', 'MaxSizeSSZ']; one row per (package, type, method); `symbols` lists the receiver forms present (a value-receiver method also has its compiler pointer wrapper)
